statement_map.email_excerpt: I'm sorry for the trouble this has caused.
You called because some of your students said your lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hope this gets sorted out.
We opened the lesson link you shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone. The video played on each, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side.
Ask one of the affected students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link. You mentioned you would do this.
We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you. We were not able to confirm a timeline on the call.
